title: DEUS Canonical Biome Identity & Material Differentiation Registry

TEMP.dominantGround: Fertile meadow turf, compacted dirt paths, woodland floor
TEMP.exposedSoil: Rich dark brown loam, organic humus, compact garden earth
TEMP.geology: Rounded field stones, weathered limestone, grey granite boulders
TEMP.vegetationForm: Broadleaf deciduous crowns, soft rounded shrub contours, upright leafy herbs
TEMP.waterEdgeBehavior: Clean gradual pebble/loam slope into clear freshwater streams and lakes; shallow sand/gravel bars
TEMP.elevationCharacter: Gentle rolling hills, earthen berms, layered limestone/granite bluffs (1-2 grid vertical)
TEMP.atmosphericCharacter: Temperate, mild, sun-dappled, clear air with soft early morning haze

verticalHooks.Z+2: Exposed high ridge crest, shallow upland soil, sparse wind-exposed vegetation
verticalHooks.Z+1: Upper terrace meadows, elevated limestone plateau ledges, rolling upland turf
verticalHooks.Z0: Canonical surface: rolling verdant meadow, clear streams, woodland floor, natural loam flats
verticalHooks.Z-1: Rich loam subsoil, taproot horizons, compact clay earth, alluvial gravel strata
verticalHooks.Z-2: Solid limestone and granite bedrock, subterranean natural caverns, groundwater aquifers

TEMP.notes: Canonical cradle of civilization and agriculture; baseline ecological balance across Project DEUS.

WET.dominantGround: Waterlogged grass, spongy peat mounds, dark mud flats, submerged marsh turf
WET.exposedSoil: Dark saturated organic muck, dense peat, soft dark river silt
WET.geology: Water-smoothed river stones, dark damp slate, moss-covered low rock slabs
WET.vegetationForm: Upright vertical reeds/rushes, drooping willow fronds, tangled root systems, floating aquatic mats
WET.waterEdgeBehavior: Indistinct saturated shoreline: water grades into mud, peat, and floating reed beds; stagnant ponds and murky oxbow channels
WET.elevationCharacter: Depressed basin, shallow swales, riverbanks, low mud shelves, raised wooden boardwalk footings
WET.atmosphericCharacter: Humid, heavy, damp, low-hanging river mist, stagnant air

verticalHooks.Z+2: Elevated wetland knoll crests, high humid air boundary, exposed ridge margins
verticalHooks.Z+1: Natural levee crest, raised peat hummock, elevated saturated ground
verticalHooks.Z0: Canonical surface: marsh pools, reed shallows, peat meadows, slow river channels
verticalHooks.Z-1: Deep anaerobic black mud, waterlogged peat strata, submerged taproots
verticalHooks.Z-2: Flooded subterranean caverns, silt-choked aquifers, underground drainage sumps

WET.notes: Major water presence, tangled organic density, rich foraging and fishing, treacherous footing.

ARID.dominantGround: Dry steppe earth, sun-baked hardpan, loose coarse sand, cracked clay washes
ARID.exposedSoil: Caliche-rich pale dry earth, cracked sun-baked clay, powdery mineral dust
ARID.geology: Layered red/buff sandstone, horizontal sedimentary strata, eroded mesa caps, warm weathered rock
ARID.vegetationForm: Isolated spiky bunchgrass clumps, twisted drought-stunted wood, thorny succulents, flat-topped umbrella canopies
ARID.waterEdgeBehavior: Ephemeral dry washes (arroyos) with cracked mud beds; rare isolated oasis/springs with narrow high-contrast verdant fringe
ARID.elevationCharacter: Flat-topped mesas, steep sandstone canyons, stepped rock benches, eroded escarpments
ARID.atmosphericCharacter: Dry, sun-bleached, intense thermal shimmer, cloudless high sky, crisp starry nights

verticalHooks.Z+2: Mesa summit, exposed sandstone caprock, wind-scoured dry surface
verticalHooks.Z+1: Upper sandstone terrace shelves, horizontal canyon rims, stepped rock ledges
verticalHooks.Z0: Canonical surface: dry steppe flats, gravel plains, arroyo washes, sandstone benches
verticalHooks.Z-1: Hardpan caliche sub-layer, dry sedimentary shale, parched subterranean gravel
verticalHooks.Z-2: Deep sandstone aquifer caverns, dry mineral/salt chambers, underground hollows

ARID.notes: Wide-open tactical lines of sight, scarce surface water, distinctive horizontal geological layering.

HIGH.dominantGround: Thin hardy turf, rock-strewn upland earth, angular gravel scree, bare bedrock
HIGH.exposedSoil: Shallow stony upland loam, weathered gravelly soil, coarse crushed rock
HIGH.geology: Sharp fractured grey granite, dark cleft slate, angular scree talus, massive bedrock cliffs
HIGH.vegetationForm: Wind-pruned krummholz conifers, low-growing cushion plants, hardy upright tussocks tucked in rock crevices
HIGH.waterEdgeBehavior: Fast-flowing cascading mountain brooks, narrow rocky rapids over clean granite, crystalline pool basins with zero mud
HIGH.elevationCharacter: Steep vertical 2-grid and multi-level cliff walls, narrow shelf passes, high plateaus, jagged ridges
HIGH.atmosphericCharacter: Cool, crisp, windswept, thin clear air, dynamic fast-moving mountain clouds

verticalHooks.Z+2: Sheer jagged granite summits, mountain horn peaks, windswept bedrock crests
verticalHooks.Z+1: Upper cliff shelves, alpine scree terraces, high rocky saddles
verticalHooks.Z0: Canonical surface: upland valley floor, rocky plateaus, cascading torrent banks, boulder flats
verticalHooks.Z-1: Fractured granite bedrock, natural fault fissures, coarse stone strata
verticalHooks.Z-2: Massive solid granite deep chambers, natural fissure chasms, deep geological faults

HIGH.notes: HARD RULE: Zero snow/ice. Emphasizes sheer physical elevation, fractured stone mass, and wind-sculpted ecology.

VOLC.dominantGround: Powdery grey-black ash drifts, scorched earth, dark volcanic gravel, crusted basalt rock
VOLC.exposedSoil: Fine mineral ash, burnt clay, sulfur-stained dark soil, heat-hardened crust
VOLC.geology: Vesicular scoria, dark columnar basalt, obsidian glass shards, porous pumice blocks
VOLC.vegetationForm: Charred skeletal trunks, stunted fire-adapted brush, pioneering geothermal moss, cracked root remnants
lowFloraVocabulary: tough volcanic tuft-grass in cool rock cracks
VOLC.waterEdgeBehavior: Steaming geothermal pools, sulfurous mineral springs with vibrant yellow-green encrusted rims; acid ponds; localized molten lava channels with cooled black rock crusts
VOLC.elevationCharacter: Fractured volcanic cones, terraced basalt steps, sudden tectonic fissures, crater rims
VOLC.atmosphericCharacter: Smoky, haze-choked, thermal updrafts, glowing embers on wind, sulfur scent

verticalHooks.Z+2: Smoking caldera rims, jagged basalt spires rising through smoke plume, fumarole crests
verticalHooks.Z+1: Upper cooling lava terraces, raised basalt ledges, obsidian outcrops
verticalHooks.Z0: Canonical surface: ash fields, active basalt fissures, geothermal pools, scorched bedrock
verticalHooks.Z-1: Porous basalt crust, subterranean magma vents, heated rock tubes
verticalHooks.Z-2: Deep magma-adjacent caverns, subterranean molten rock conduits, massive obsidian seams

VOLC.notes: Lava is an accent feature / danger node, not a wallpaper flood. Dominant visual palette is dark charcoal, basalt, and ash with localized thermal heat.

stoneRubble.description: Loose stone elements present across biomes with distinct physical form and prevalence

prevalence.HIGH: VERY_DENSE (massive fractured scree and talus chips)
prevalence.VOLC: DENSE (porous scoria, obsidian flakes, basalt blocks)

earthSubstrate.description: Base ground soil layer across biomes

prevalence.TEMP: DENSE (fertile organic loam with active humus)
prevalence.WET: VERY_DENSE (anaerobic black muck and fibrous peat)
prevalence.ARID: VERY_DENSE (sun-baked caliche clay and mineral dust)
prevalence.HIGH: SPARSE (thin stony grit in rock depressions)
prevalence.VOLC: DENSE (powdery volcanic ash and scorched earth)

woodTimber.description: Wood elements and harvestable forestry debris

prevalence.TEMP: DENSE (healthy broadleaf logs, oak timber, leafy branches)
prevalence.WET: MODERATE (waterlogged driftwood, spongy alder logs, weeping willow roots)
prevalence.ARID: VERY_SPARSE (bleached gnarled branches, dry ironwood roots)
prevalence.HIGH: SPARSE_TO_MODERATE (dense-grained mountain pine, resinous conifer logs)
prevalence.VOLC: SPARSE (calcined charcoal, burned snags, charred timber)

prevalence.TEMP: MODERATE (clear meandering streams, ponds with pebble shores)
prevalence.WET: VERY_DENSE (dominant marsh pools, river shallows, slow channels)
prevalence.ARID: VERY_SPARSE (rare isolated springs, ephemeral flash-flood washes)
prevalence.HIGH: MODERATE (fast tumbling cold torrents, crystalline waterfalls)
prevalence.VOLC: SPARSE (bubbling geothermal springs, steaming pools, acid tarns)

ROCK.TEMP: Rounded fieldstone boulders, weathered limestone with smoothed edges, mossy granite
ROCK.WET: Water-slicked river cobbles, submerged flat stepping stones, moss-blanketed low slabs
ROCK.ARID: Horizontally bedded sandstone, stepped canyon shelves, sharp wind-faceted planar cleavage, flaky shale
ROCK.HIGH: Sharply angular fractured granite and cleft slate, steep vertical jointing, jagged wedge-shaped scree chips
ROCK.VOLC: Highly porous vesicular scoria, hexagonal columnar basalt jointing, glass-sharp obsidian fragments, jagged cooling fractures

SOIL.TEMP: Clumpy, crumbly organic loam with visible humus and rootlets
SOIL.WET: Saturated, spongy, cohesive dark muck and fibrous peat
SOIL.ARID: Polygonal shrinkage cracks in hardpan, powdery fine dust, loose coarse sand grains
SOIL.HIGH: Gritty, gravel-heavy crushed rock fragments with minimal organic binding
SOIL.VOLC: Fine air-fall powdery ash drifts, brittle baked crusts, volcanic cinders

VEGETATION.TEMP: Soft billowing broadleaf crowns, rounded leafy shrubs, lush continuous turf
VEGETATION.WET: Vertical sword-like reeds, weeping droop forms, floating circular lily pads, sprawling root networks
VEGETATION.ARID: Isolated radial spiky bunchgrass, succulent fleshy pads, gnarly twisted drought wood, thorny scrub
VEGETATION.HIGH: Tight hemispherical cushion plants, wind-sheared one-sided krummholz pines, crevice-hugging lichens
VEGETATION.VOLC: Skeletal leafless charred limbs, pioneering rosette fireweeds, sulfur-tolerant encrustations

WATER.TEMP: Gentle translucent surface, rounded pebble beds, clean sand bars
WATER.WET: Murky, peat-tinted water with floating duckweed and submerged reed stalks
WATER.ARID: Cracked dry mud wash beds with rare isolated clear oasis pools
WATER.HIGH: Frothing white water cascades over dark granite, crystalline transparent pools
WATER.VOLC: Steaming geothermal pools with vibrant sulfur-encrusted mineral edges; localized molten lava channels with crusted cooling edges

DEBRIS.TEMP: Autumn leaf litter, fallen leafy branches, decaying woodland logs, small pebbles
DEBRIS.WET: Waterlogged driftwood snags, tangled root clumps, sodden peat chunks
DEBRIS.ARID: Sun-bleached animal skulls and ribs, sun-cracked dry twigs, windblown tumbleweed
DEBRIS.HIGH: Freshly broken rockfall rubble, angular slate chips, weathered alpine wood fragments
DEBRIS.VOLC: Black charcoal chunks, porous pumice stones, sharp obsidian flakes, drifted ash banks

differentiationTests.GRAYSCALE_MATERIAL_TEST: In grayscale, can the biome be identified instantly from structural forms, fracture geometry, and substrate texture alone without hue cues?
differentiationTests.SILHOUETTE_FORM_TEST: Do rock, tree, and shrub silhouettes have distinct structural geometries (e.g. rounded fieldstone vs stepped sandstone vs jagged granite vs columnar basalt)?
differentiationTests.ECOLOGICAL_DENSITY_TEST: Does vegetation distribution reflect authentic moisture and soil regimes (e.g. dense continuous turf in Temperate vs isolated spiky bunchgrass in Arid)?
differentiationTests.BARE_SUBSTRATE_TEST: If all props and decorative objects are removed, does the bare ground tile clearly identify its biome (loam vs peat vs caliche vs mountain gravel vs ash)?

TEMP_WET.grassDensity: Dense verdant turf -> increasingly saturated, spongy tussocks and reed clusters
TEMP_WET.soilTransition: Rich brown loam -> damp dark organic earth -> soft saturated black peat/mud
TEMP_WET.geologyTransition: Rounded dry fieldstones -> damp slick stone -> half-submerged river pebbles
TEMP_WET.moistureTransition: Moderate -> High (water table rises to surface)
TEMP_WET.vegetationForm: Broadleaf oak/meadow -> water-tolerant alders, weeping willows, upright cattails
TEMP_WET.topography: Rolling meadows and gentle rises -> low drainage basin and marsh pockets

TEMP_ARID.grassDensity: Continuous dense turf -> thinning patch grass -> isolated dry bunchgrass clumps
TEMP_ARID.soilTransition: Rich dark brown loam -> pale sandy loam -> sun-baked clay and caliche hardpan
TEMP_ARID.geologyTransition: Grey granite/limestone -> warm sandstone and sedimentary rock ledges
TEMP_ARID.vegetationForm: Lush broadleaf woodland -> drought-stunted scrub, thorn bushes, open steppe
TEMP_ARID.topography: Rolling loam hills -> broad flat steppe plains, dry wash arroyos, and sandstone shelves

TEMP_HIGH.grassDensity: Soft meadow grass -> thinner, tougher alpine fescue and crevice moss
TEMP_HIGH.soilTransition: Deep fertile topsoil -> shallow stony upland soil -> coarse gravel scree
TEMP_HIGH.geologyTransition: Weathered fieldstones -> massive fractured granite cliffs and angular slate
TEMP_HIGH.moistureTransition: Moderate -> Variable (rapid downhill runoff, well-drained slopes)
TEMP_HIGH.vegetationForm: Broadleaf oak/birch forest -> wind-shaped mountain pines, hardy alpine scrub (NO SNOW)
TEMP_HIGH.topography: Gentle valley floor -> steep rocky slopes, 2-grid vertical cliffs, and high passes

TEMP_VOLC.grassDensity: Verdant green turf -> yellowing scorched grass -> barren ash drifts with rare pioneer fireweed
TEMP_VOLC.soilTransition: Living dark loam -> heat-desiccated earth -> powdery dark ash and scorched gravel
TEMP_VOLC.geologyTransition: Sedimentary/granite boulders -> heat-fractured dark rock -> porous scoria and columnar basalt
TEMP_VOLC.vegetationForm: Living broadleaf forest -> dead charred standing timber -> bare volcanic rock with rare scrub
TEMP_VOLC.topography: Soft rolling hills -> rugged tectonic fissures, volcanic break-slopes, and basalt ridges

WET_ARID.grassDensity: Dense marsh reeds and swamp grass -> rapid drop-off to sparse spiky bunchgrass around shrinking salt pans
WET_ARID.soilTransition: Dark saturated peat and black mud -> alkaline drying mud -> cracked sun-baked clay hardpan and salt crust
WET_ARID.geologyTransition: Damp dark river stones -> salt-encrusted shale -> warm layered sandstone
WET_ARID.moistureTransition: High -> Low (extreme moisture gradient: evaporation terminal basin)
WET_ARID.vegetationForm: Waterlogged willows and cattails -> desiccated reed stalks -> spiny drought scrub
WET_ARID.topography: Low marsh basin -> drying alluvial fan -> flat sun-baked playa and eroded arroyos

WET_HIGH.grassDensity: Spongy bog turf and reeds -> cold rushing mountain brook moss -> tough crevice alpine grass
WET_HIGH.soilTransition: Deep organic peat and mud -> coarse alluvial gravel -> thin stony mountain soil and bare bedrock
WET_HIGH.geologyTransition: Silt-covered river stones -> tumbled granite river boulders -> sheer angular granite/slate walls
WET_HIGH.moistureTransition: High stagnant -> High dynamic (stagnant bog transitions to high-velocity mountain drainage)
WET_HIGH.vegetationForm: Bog alders and weeping willows -> mountain conifers and water-hugging birch along gorge
WET_HIGH.topography: Flat low marsh -> steep rocky gorge, waterfalls, and towering granite cliffs (NO SNOW)

WET_VOLC.grassDensity: Dense reed beds -> scalded swamp tussocks -> steaming mineral mud with sulfur algae
WET_VOLC.soilTransition: Organic peat muck -> steaming sulfur mud -> hot black ash and mineral encrustations
WET_VOLC.geologyTransition: Dark wet river gravel -> thermal fractured stone -> porous dark scoria and basalt vents
WET_VOLC.moistureTransition: High ambient -> Extreme localized geothermal boiling/steaming
WET_VOLC.vegetationForm: Lush swamp greenery -> scalded deadwood snags -> geothermal algae and sulfur lichen
WET_VOLC.topography: Flat marsh basin -> steaming hot springs, bubbling mud pots, and basalt crater rim

ARID_HIGH.grassDensity: Sparse bunchgrass on steppe -> tough alpine cushion grass and rock lichen on windward slopes
ARID_HIGH.soilTransition: Sun-baked caliche and sand -> coarse alluvial scree -> shallow rocky mountain soil
ARID_HIGH.geologyTransition: Warm horizontal sandstone strata -> transitional conglomerate -> massive vertical grey granite and slate
ARID_HIGH.moistureTransition: Low -> Variable (dry rain shadow transitions to cooler, windward slopes)
ARID_HIGH.vegetationForm: Thorny desert scrub -> sparse mountain juniper -> wind-pruned mountain pines (NO SNOW)
ARID_HIGH.topography: Desert flat and canyon washes -> steep rugged escarpment, rock scree talus, and mountain peaks

ARID_VOLC.grassDensity: Sparse drought bunchgrass -> scorched brittle scrub -> bare ash drifts and lava crust
ARID_VOLC.soilTransition: Pale caliche clay and sand -> burnt red/brown earth -> dark powdery volcanic ash
ARID_VOLC.geologyTransition: Sedimentary sandstone ledges -> dark heat-altered shale -> black columnar basalt and obsidian
ARID_VOLC.vegetationForm: Drought-adapted spiny scrub -> dead bleached/charred branches -> bare volcanic rock
ARID_VOLC.topography: Desert mesas and dry washes -> jagged tectonic fault scarps, basalt plains, and volcanic cones

HIGH_VOLC.grassDensity: Tough alpine crevice grass -> blackened alpine moss -> barren volcanic ash and basalt bedrock
HIGH_VOLC.soilTransition: Shallow stony mountain gravel -> sulfur-dusted gravel -> dense black ash and scoria
HIGH_VOLC.geologyTransition: Sharp fractured grey granite and slate -> heat-fractured igneous rock -> columnar basalt and lava vents
HIGH_VOLC.moistureTransition: Cool mountain drainage -> hot dry geothermal vents
HIGH_VOLC.vegetationForm: Hardy mountain conifers (NO SNOW) -> scorched timber snags -> zero vegetation near volcanic crests
HIGH_VOLC.topography: Sheer granite mountain peaks -> jagged volcanic caldera rims, smoking vents, and basalt slopes
